selected_evidence.requirement: Restrict SSH login access to members of remote-access
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the installed policy, successful sshd validation, effective `allowgroups remote-access`, active listeners, and live SSH endpoint before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Add opsadmin to the local remote-access group
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the local group creation, opsadmin membership, `/etc/group` entry, and persisted membership after restart.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID `45c22b1f-31bf-419b-a1a4-331c4aa1a40a`, acknowledged reboot scheduling, changed boot ID `267ab531-1b52-44ad-a675-f3c80d57c3ff`, and fully recovered SSH configuration, service, listener, endpoint, and account/group data.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'OPSADMIN='; getent passwd opsadmin || true
printf 'REMOTE_ACCESS_GROUP='; getent group remote-access || true
printf 'SSHD_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active sshd || true
printf 'SSHD_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled sshd || true
printf 'SSHD_LISTENERS\n'; ss -tlnp | sed -n '/sshd/p'
printf 'CONFIG_INCLUDES\n'; sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*Include[[:space:]]/p' /etc/ssh/sshd_config 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'ACCESS_DIRECTIVES\n'; grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*(AllowGroups|DenyGroups|AllowUsers|DenyUsers)[[:space:]]' /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'EFFECTIVE_ACCESS\n'; sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(allowgroups|denygroups|allowusers|denyusers) ' || true
printf 'CONFIG_TEST='; if sshd -t; then printf 'ok\n'; else printf 'failed\n'; fi

commands.command:
set -eu
if grep -q '^remote-access:' /etc/group; then
  printf 'local group remote-access already exists\n'
else
  groupadd remote-access
  printf 'created local group remote-access\n'
fi
getent group remote-access
grep '^remote-access:' /etc/group
commands.stdout:
created local group remote-access
remote-access:x:1000:
remote-access:x:1000:

commands.command:
set -eu
if getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then
  printf 'account opsadmin already exists\n'
else
  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin
  printf 'created local account opsadmin\n'
fi
usermod --append --groups remote-access opsadmin
printf 'PASSWD_ENTRY\n'; getent passwd opsadmin
printf 'IDENTITY\n'; id opsadmin
printf 'LOCAL_GROUP_ENTRY\n'; grep '^remote-access:' /etc/group
commands.stdout:
created local account opsadmin
PASSWD_ENTRY
opsadmin:x:1000:1001::/home/opsadmin:/bin/bash
IDENTITY
uid=1000(opsadmin) gid=1001(opsadmin) groups=1001(opsadmin),1000(remote-access)
LOCAL_GROUP_ENTRY
remote-access:x:1000:opsadmin

commands.command:
set -eu
cfg_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/.60-remote-access.conf.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' '# Managed SSH login restriction: only members of remote-access may log in.' 'AllowGroups remote-access' > "$cfg_tmp"
chmod 0600 "$cfg_tmp"
mv "$cfg_tmp" /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
if ! sshd -t; then
  rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
  printf 'new configuration failed validation and was removed\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
systemctl reload sshd
printf 'INSTALLED_CONFIG\n'; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
sed -n '1,20p' /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
printf 'CONFIG_TEST=ok\n'
printf 'SSHD_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active sshd
commands.stdout:
INSTALLED_CONFIG
root:root 600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/60-remote-access.conf
# Managed SSH login restriction: only members of remote-access may log in.
AllowGroups remote-access
CONFIG_TEST=ok
SSHD_ACTIVE=active
